products.name: Good Honey Creamed Clover, 16oz
products.description:
The Ashusrt Family are 5th generation bee keepers, home harvesting honey in the USA since 1919.

Their Montana Creamed Clover honey is their raw and pure, using their unique creaming method. Good Honey’s creamed clover is whipped and chilled to perfection, creating a luxuriously smooth and spreadable texture. Crafted from only the finest clover blossoms, their creamed honey boasts a rich and delicate sweetness with a perfect velvety finish. It’s great for spreading over warm toast, stirring into tea, or enjoying by the spoonful!

products.name: Good Honey Montana Clover, 16oz
products.description:
The Ashusrt Family are 5th generation bee keepers, home harvesting honey in the USA since 1919.

Their Montana Clover Honey is the Olympic gold medal of honeys. When Montana Clover blooms in the summer months, Beekeepers and bees alike spend countless hours looking for this liquid gold. Although there are over 300 varieties of clover flowers, Montana Sweet Clover (Melilotus officinalis) is prized for its superior taste. They harvest it as a pure Montana clover, meaning it is not blended with other varieties, and is among some of the lightest colored honeys produced. Our favorite quality is its candied sweetness. If you’re looking for the most premium & tasty honey, look no further!

Delicate and sweet with clean floral notes. (A finishing honey)

products.name: Good Honey San Diego Citrus, 16oz
products.description:
The Ashusrt Family are 5th generation bee keepers, home harvesting honey in the USA since 1919.

San Diego Orange groves have a variety of Citrus fruits that come together to create the unique & signature taste of Southern California.

This delectable nectar leaves as quick as it comes, creating a small window to collect this prized honey. San Diego citrus is like sunshine in a jar, enjoy!

Juicy, jammy, bright and balanced

products.name: OroLiquido Marcona Almond Butter, 160g
products.tagline: fresh roasted marcona almonds & sea salt!
products.description: OroLiquido is a crunchy, creamy nut butter made with only two ingredients: Roasted Marcona almonds and sea salt. this "liquid gold" is delicious as an ice cream topping, on freshly baked bread with honey, or eaten by the spoonful!

products.name: Ayako Apricot Jam, 6oz
products.description:
In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima.

This jam has a true apricot flavor balanced by notes of lemon zest and honeysuckle. Great on your morning toast with coffee, or fantastic with aged sheep's milk cheeses.

products.name: Ayako Damson Plum Jam, 6oz
products.description:
In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima.

Damson Plum is a small, pear shaped heirloom fruit distinctive for its violet hues and punchy skins.

products.name: Ayako Greengage Plum Jam, 6oz
products.description:
In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima.

Greengage Plums are a queen of plums, visually distinctive for their ethereal, ashy pink and chartreuse skins. Best known for their confectionary flavors, this jam provides intense, almost dried fruit concentration, think ripe apricot, with complex aromas of lemon verbena and orange blossom.

products.name: Ayako Italian Plum Jam, 6oz
products.description:
In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima.

The Italian Plums are a ubiquitous variety here in the Pacific Northwest and known worldwide for its distinctive confectionary quality, both fresh and cooked. This European variety boasts a large oval sillhouette with dark violet skins and bright yellow flesh. When cooked, it offers the flavors of fresh mission fig with such a hint of honeysuckle on the finish.

products.name: Ayako Mirabelle Plum Jam, 6oz
products.description:
In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima.

Mirabelle Plum is a European plum species known for its flecked golden skin in palm sized spheres. This jam offers intense, almost dried fruit concentration reminiscent of meyer lemon marmalade with honey.

products.name: La Trinquelinette Apricot Jam, 370g
products.description: This apricot jam is made in a small batches by a small family business in the village of Saint-Léger-Vauban in the Burgundy region. This area of France is known for its fertile soil and vineyards. All their jams are made with local fruit and brown unrefined sugar. Some of the jams are thicken with pectinei and some use rhubarb.Not too sweet, but sweet enough - perfect for your toasted baguette, French butter & coffee!

products.name: Pojer e Sandri Quince Syrup, 150g
products.description:
Pojer e Sandri Cold Pressed Quince Syrup is made from 100% cold concentrated quince juice, and nothing else.

Their estate’s orchard is located at 700 meters and is surrounded by forest, an ideal location for organically cultivating two varieties of quince, Ronda and Silver. Every fall, they cold press carefully selected fruit into juice. Using a unique vacuum processing, Pojer e Sandri are able to concentrate the quince juice to a thick, maple syrup consistency without adding any sugar. Thus, the intrinsic characteristics of the quince remain intact in the final product.

Pojer e Sandri has truly captured the essence of quince. Unlike most sugary syrups, this Quince Syrup bursts with a tannic tartness balanced by just enough natural sweetness. The quince fruit’s distinct aromas and notes of plum, molasses, and pine are concentrated. One spoonful packs a flavorful punch that evokes the mountainous region from which it originates.

products.name: Fabbri Amarena Cherries in Syrup, 120g
products.tagline: The Classic Amarena Cherry in Syrup!
products.description: The Fabbri Company of Bologna has been making uniquely delicious cherries in amarena syrup for over a century. Only the best wild cherries are carefully selected and candied in amarena syrup according to Gennaro Fabbri's original recipe, created in 1905. Eat them straight out of the crock, add them to cobblers and cakes, or top a perfect bowl of vanilla ice cream.

products.name: Bees Knees Meyer Lemon Honey, 10oz
products.description: Made by Bushwick Kitchens in Brooklyn, USA. Combining sweet honey from the Hudson Valley with a bright squeeze of citrus, Bees Knees Meyer Lemon Honey is great on anything from a fresh baked scone to a bowl of berries to a plate of fried chicken.

products.name: Bees Knees Salted Honey, 10oz
products.description: Made by Bushwick Kitchens in Brooklyn, USA. Fragrant wildflower honey from the Hudson Valley is infused with sea salt, creating a honey with the perfect balance of sweet and salty. It is great on anything from soft goat cheese to a piece of freshly buttered toast to a scoop of warm fruit cobbler.

products.name: Bees Knees Spicy Honey, 10oz
products.description: Made by Bushwick Kitchens in Brooklyn, USA. This wildflower honey from the Hudson Valley is infused with a custom spicy mix of chile peppers, delivering the perfect balance of sweet heat. It is great on anything from a warm buttered biscuit to a cold bowl of ice cream, to the perfect vinaigrette.

products.name: Girl Meets Dirt Ginny Jam, 7.75oz
products.description:
In an orchard by the sea (Warm Valley Orchard) lies a grove of old Italian Plum trees, harvested by long time islanders Bob & Maria Nutt. These beautiful plums have been crated off to Seattle the past few years to be soaked with botanicals in gin by Copperworks Distilling for their lauded & award winning Plum Gin (side note, Bob is brothers with Copperworks Founder Micah and Audra bought her first Shiro Plums aside from the farmette tree, from the Nutt family).

A few years back we fielded a call from Copperworks- basically- hey- we’ve got these boozy plums we normally compost but maybe you want them? HECK YA we do.

So in true full circle fashion we picked up a truckload of buckets of the inaugural 2021 season island Italian plums that had spent most of 2022 on the lash in a gin bath and brought them back home. We rolled up our sleeves and hand pitted each and every one of them, added some sugar and a squeeze of lemon to the party and have an exquisite new limited edition preserve!

products.name: Girl Meets Dirt Hot Damn Pepper Jam Spoon Preserves, 7.75oz
products.description:
The Girl Meets Dirt crew is really into fruit, but their farmers grow great vegetables too! Time to fire up the peppers. The result is a not so usual pepper jelly. They gave it the old GMD spin and maxxed out the spiciness but added lots of local fruit and a bit of punchy organic vinegar (made from WA apples) for balance. The quince and apple add body to the set allowing GMD to stay committed to their ‘no pectin’ policy. It’s legit hot (yes!). It’s legit amazing. And it’s all natural.

This is one of those jars you need in your refrigerator to spice up lackluster meals (visualize dipping coconut shrimp or topping grilled salmon) and serve as an instant cheese pairing by slathering on cream cheese and crackers at a moment’s notice. They're a game-changer for any charcuterie board or cheeseboard!

products.name: Girl Meets Dirt Orcas Pear, 7.75oz
products.description: At the height of ripeness Girl Meets Dirt picks Orcas Island pears and cooks them into a rosy preserve, with notes of ginger from their fresh kitchen garden grown bay leaves. Highly versatile, this preserve is a gorgeous topping to pannacotta and cheesecake.

products.name: Girl Meets Dirt Pear Balsamic. 7.75oz
products.description: This jam is always a star on a cheeseboard or grazing board with taleggio, asiago and blues. Truly an all-purpose condiment – try it over ice cream. Or play around – add a few glugs of balsamic to a teaspoonful, extra virgin olive oil, salt, and minced shallots and puree it together for a quick, rich vinaigrette for a salad (topped with blue cheese, fresh pear slices, and crispy shallots). Spoon it over a wedge of Rogue River Blue with wafer thin crackers or fresh pear slices for an intensely satisfying cheese pairing.

products.name: Girl Meets Dirt Rhuberry Preserves, 220g
products.description:
The Girl Meets Dirt crew is really into fruit, but their farmers grow great vegetables too! Time to fire up the peppers. The result is a not so usual pepper jelly. They gave it the old GMD spin and maxxed out the spiciness but added lots of local fruit and a bit of punchy organic vinegar (made from WA apples) for balance. The quince and apple add body to the set allowing GMD to stay committed to their ‘no pectin’ policy. It’s legit hot (yes!). It’s legit amazing. And it’s all natural.

This bright ruby small batch Reserve folds grassy red rhubarb from Ralph's Greenhouse in the Skagit Valley and from JBS Farm in Crow Valley on Orcas (where John and Susan Fleischer tend crowns that have been in the ground for fifty years) with tart, plump Northwest raspberries — classically preserved in just six copper pots, the way they always have.

products.name: Tree Knees Cinnamon Maple Syrup, 13.5oz
products.description: Rich maple syrup from the Catskill Mountains is infused with cassia cinnamon from Indonesia, creating the ultimate tag team of flavors. Trees Knees Cinnamon Maple is great in iced coffee, drizzled over baked fruit, or poured over hot waffles.

products.name: Villa Jerada Buckwheat Honey, 16oz
products.description:
Yakima Valley buckwheat honey showcasing the bounty and diversity of plants and source of pollen for the bees. Often compared to the (overhyped) Manuka honey, many clinical studies have shown that buckwheat honey is as healthy and nutritious.

Villa Jerada buckwheat honey is unfiltered, raw, full of complex flavors such as molasses and caramel. It pairs well with raw milk cheeses, fruits, teas and in a simple baguette slice with olive oil and a generous drizzle on top.

products.name: Runamok Bourbon Barrel-Aged Pure Maple Syrup, 12.7 oz
products.description: Founded in 2009 by husband-and-wife team Eric and Laura Sorkin, Runamok combines high quality ingredients, innovative flavors, and eye-catching packaging to create excellent maple syrups. This syrup is aged in recently-emptied bourbon barrels, allowing the essence of bourbon to shine through.

products.name: Runamok Sugar Maker's Cut Pure Maple Syrup, 12.7 oz
products.tagline: The Season's Best Pure Maple Syrup!
products.description: Founded in 2009 by husband-and-wife team Eric and Laura Sorkin, Runamok combines high quality ingredients and innovative flavors to create excellent maple syrups. This Grade A Vermont maple syrup is a beautiful amber hue, with a rich flavor to complement any pancake breakfast.

products.name: Runamok Whiskey Barrel Aged Pure Maple Syrup, 12.7 oz
products.description: Founded in 2009 by husband-and-wife team Eric and Laura Sorkin, Runamok combines high quality ingredients, innovative flavors, and eye-catching packaging to create excellent maple syrups. This syrup is aged in recently-emptied whiskey barrels, allowing the essence of whiskey to shine through.

products.name: Casina Rossa Saffron & Acacia Honey, 140g
products.description: Casina Rossa is a brand of artisan food products from the Abruzzo region of Italy created by Nicola and Paola DeLaurentiis. Their Saffron & Acacia Honey is complements aged cheeses, ice cream, or even roasted chicken or scallops.

products.name: Faugier Creme de Marrons, 17oz
products.description: Clement Faugier created the recipe for his famous chestnut spread in 1885. Not 1985, 1885. It has stood the test of time and is still perfect to spread on your morning toast, a fresh baguette or crepes. It's sweet & creamy with a hint of vanilla - making it a staple in French cooking & baking.

products.name: Inna Jam Meyer Lemon
products.description: Inna Jam, located in the Bay Area, sources all its organic produce from within 150 miles of their Emeryville kitchen. Their single-varietal jams rely on the best possible fruit and are intended to showcase the natural subtleties and bright flavors of the fruit. There is no mixing of fruit or added flavorings. Each jar is a time capsule of single-sourced fruit. Their Meyer Lemon has the floral, lemony bite of Meyer lemons, the bitter tinge distinctive of citrus marmalades, and the sweet-but-not-too-sweet balance typical of Inna jams.

products.name: Inna Jam Plenty Spicy Jalapeno Jam, 10oz
products.description: Pronounced like "I'm in a jam" - inn-ah. No matter how you say it, Inna's makes amazing seasonal jams from fresh, organic, seasonal fruit sourced from within 150 miles of their Emeryville, CA kitchen. The Spicy Jalapeño, Inna's signature jam, has more kick than other pepper jellies because they use the entire pepper, seeds and all! This results in a spicy-sweet and completely addictive jam with distinct jalapeño flavors. Go old school with your favorite cracker, cream cheese, smoked salmon & Inna's Spicy Jalapeno!

products.name: Marchesi di San Giulano Mandarin Orange Marmalade, 460g
products.description: The San Giuliano estate is in the foothills of Mount Etna and boasts some of the most fertile soil in Sicily. Some of the finest citrus fruits in Italy grow there. All their jam production is done on the San Giuliano estate by hand in small batches with simple, family recipes. Freshly picked organic fruit is hand-sliced and cooked down slowly with only cane sugar. They never use thickeners or preservatives. Their Sicilian Mandarin Marmalade gets its burnt orange color from the sweet, juicy mandarins that hang ripe from the trees like ornaments in late December, leading some to call it the Christmas Orange. The marmalade is sweet and fragrant with enough acidity to give it complexity. Fabulous on crusty toast with butter, but also a sophisticated addition to almost any dessert.

products.name: Marchesi di San Giuliano Clementine Orange Marmalade, 460g
products.description: The San Giuliano estate is in the foothills of Mount Etna and boasts some of the most fertile soil in Sicily. Some of the finest citrus fruits in Italy grow there. All their jam production is done on the San Giuliano estate by hand in small batches with simple, family recipes. Freshly picked organic fruit is hand-sliced and cooked down slowly with only cane sugar. They never use thickeners or preservatives. Their Sicilian Clementine Marmalade is made with a juicy varietal of mandarin. The high proportion of fruit picked at peak ripeness and prepared simply with natural ingredients give this jam an incomparable flavor. Great on toast and pairs well with cheeses such as ricotta.

products.name: Marchesi di San Giuliano Lemon Marmalade, 460g
products.description: The San Giuliano estate is in the foothills of Mount Etna and boasts some of the most fertile soil in Sicily. Some of the finest citrus fruits in Italy grow there. All their jam production is done on the San Giuliano estate by hand in small batches with simple, family recipes. Freshly picked organic fruit is hand-sliced and cooked down slowly with only cane sugar. They never use thickeners or preservatives. Bright and tangy, with the sweet bitterness of caramelized fruit, their Sicilian Lemon Marmalade bursts with the flavor of Sicily’s treasured lemons. Great on toast and croissants, but also makes a lovely filling for tarts.

products.name: Marchesi di San Giuliano Red Grapefruit Marmalade, 460g
products.description: The San Giuliano estate is in the foothills of Mount Etna and boasts some of the most fertile soil in Sicily. Some of the finest citrus fruits in Italy grow there. All their jam production is done on the San Giuliano estate by hand in small batches with simple, family recipes. Freshly picked organic fruit is hand-sliced and cooked down slowly with only cane sugar. They never use thickeners or preservatives. Their Sicilian Red Grapefruit Marmalade is sweet and tangy with a clean, bright flavor. Tender slices of aromatic grapefruit add to the texture and give the marmalade a pleasant bitterness. Excellent on toast with creamy butter, as a topping for ice cream, or swirled into yogurt.

products.name: Marchesi di San Giuliano Sicilian Bitter Orange Marmalade, 460g
products.description: The San Giuliano estate is in the foothills of Mount Etna and boasts some of the most fertile soil in Sicily. Some of the finest citrus fruits in Italy grow there. All their jam production is done on the San Giuliano estate by hand in small batches with simple, family recipes. Freshly picked organic fruit is hand-sliced and cooked down slowly with only cane sugar. They never use thickeners or preservatives. Their Sicilian Bitter Orange Marmalade is made with the Arancia Rossa di Sicilia, the blood orange of Sicily. Its bright crimson flesh is both tart and sweet. Excellent on bread or with baked brie.

products.name: Marchesi di San Giuliano Sicilian Orange Marmalade, 460g
products.description: The San Giuliano estate is in the foothills of Mount Etna and boasts some of the most fertile soil in Sicily. Some of the finest citrus fruits in Italy grow there. All their jam production is done on the San Giuliano estate by hand in small batches with simple, family recipes. Freshly picked organic fruit is hand-sliced and cooked down slowly with only cane sugar. They never use thickeners or preservatives. Their Sicilian Orange Marmalade is made with Arancia Rossa di Sicilia, the blood orange of Sicily. Its bright crimson flesh is both tart and fruity. The marmalade has a well-crafted balance of fragrant citrus and gentle sweetness. Lovely on a slice of toasted, crusty bread or dollop a spoonful on vanilla ice cream.

products.name: Mike's Hot Honey, 12oz
products.description: Michael Kurtz, inspired by the chili infused honey he discovered while living in Brazil, set out to make his own version upon his return to the US. He ended up creating the perfect accompaniment for his favorite food - pizza. After an apprenticeship at one of New York's hottest pizzarias and doing a lot of experimenting, Mike's Hot Honey was ready for the public. At first, it was just for restaurant use. It didn't take long for customers to start requesting to-go orders of the honey, and he discovered there might actully be a larger market for his honey. This is truly an incredibly versatile condiment - try on pizza, chicken, ribs, biscuits, fruits, cheese, even in cocktails.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Organic Rosemary Honey, 8.8oz
products.description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Organic Rosemary Honey is made in Southern Italy by beekeeper Fabio Lacovanelli who reserves his harvest exclusively for Ritrovo. The bees forage on organic rosemary blossoms, which gives the pale amber honey a piney aroma and full-bodied sweetness. Toast is an obvious choice and always excellent but consider adding some to cheese plates. Just a little honey complements the salty nature of cheese. You can drizzle it over a wedge or put it in a ramekin and let your guests spoon it out on their own. Especially good with goat cheese, brie, aged pecorino and camembert.

products.name: Ritrovo Selections Sicilian Pistachio Cream, 8oz
products.description: Ritrovo Selections is a premium importer of foods that represent Italy’s traditions and quality. Ritrovo means to rediscover in Italian. Over the last 20 years, the Seattle-based company has vastly expanded its line of products and won numerous international awards for quality. Their Pistachio Cream is obsession worthy. It’s made with just two ingredients: cane sugar and organic Sicilian pistachios from the foothills of Mount Etna, where the best pistachios in the world are grown. This pure, sweet spread is used in Italy for pastries, cake fillings, and gelati. But you’ll probably find yourself spreading it on toast or just eating it straight from the jar.

products.name: Apicoltura Dr. Pescia Chestnut Honey, 250g
products.description: Paolo Pescia, a passionate second-generation honey maker, practices “nomadic” beekeeping. He transports his beehives to seasonally flowering zones and protected national parks located in the Tuscan coastal hills, producing monofloral honeys of stunning flavor. All production is done by hand, including the scraping of honey from the combs. All of Pescia's honeys are raw, unpasteurized, unfiltered, and contain no artificial colors or sweeteners. This bronze-colored honey comes from a chestnut forest near Pescia's farm in the Tuscan hills. With an intense molasses-like bouquet and flavor, it is ideal as a condiment for both aged cheeses and fresh ricotta. It is also great with roasted squash and meats.

products.name: Ayako Suyematsu Raspberry Jam, 6oz
products.description: In the summer of 2010, Ayako Gordon founded Ayako & Family Jams. Partnering with Japanese Organic farmer Katsumi Taki, they sought to bring the rarest of European and Asiatic plum varieties to the pantries of preserves lovers around the globe. 100% of the fruit for this artisan jam is grown on Taki's organic Japanese farm near Yakima. This jam is a limited edition flavor, produced with Raspberries grown and harvested at Suyematsu Organic Farm on Bainbridge Island, WA in honor of Japanese Farmer Akio Suyematsu.

products.name: Casa Forcella Crab Apple Mostarda, 5oz
products.description: Mostarda is a classic Italian condiment that combines the sweet-tart notes of candied fruit with the spiciness of mustard. This apple mostarda is a perfect complement to pecorinos such as Pecorino Toscano or Piccolo Canestrato, and adds an adventurous zing to any charcuterie board. Casa Forcello founder Paola Calciolari utilizes locally-sourced fruit and her grandmother’s traditional recipes to create a truly exceptional mostarda.

products.name: Casa Forcella Pear Mostarda, 5oz
products.description: Mostarda is a classic Italian condiment that combines the sweet-tart notes of candied fruit with the spiciness of mustard. This pear mostarda is a perfect complement to pecorinos such as Pecorino Toscano or Piccolo Canestrato, and adds an adventurous zing to any charcuterie board. Casa Forcello founder Paola Calciolari utilizes locally-sourced fruit and her grandmother’s traditional recipes to create a truly exceptional mostarda.

products.name: Casa Forcella Plum Mostarda, 5oz
products.description: Mostarda is a classic Italian condiment that combines the sweet-tart notes of candied fruit with the spiciness of mustard. This plum mostarda is a perfect complement to pecorinos such as Pecorino Toscano or Piccolo Canestrato, and adds an adventurous zing to any charcuterie board. Casa Forcello founder Paola Calciolari utilizes locally-sourced fruit and her grandmother’s traditional recipes to create a truly exceptional mostarda.

products.name: Chateau Miraval Lavendar Honey, 500g
products.description: Château Miraval Lavender Honey is a rare, limited-edition, raw honey produced directly on the Provence property, often harvested in the summer or fall by resident beekeeper Noel Patterson. It is known for its delicate floral taste and creamy texture, reflecting the aromatic lavender fields surrounding the estate.

products.name: Dalmatia Fig & Orange Spread, 240g
products.description: Dalmatia combines the sweetness of Croatian figs with the zesty pop of coastal oranges. Made with care using hand-selected fruits, this is the perfect accompaniment to your charcuterie or cheese board. It pairs nicely with blue cheeses such as Bleu des Basque or Mitibleu, bloomy rind cheeses such as Brie du Pommier or Fromage de Meaux, or with fresh ricotta and walnuts over toasted bread. It’s not limited to cheese, however. It’s the perfect complement to your morning coffee when spread liberally on toast with butter.

products.name: Dalmatia Fig Spread, 240g
products.description: As good on toast as it is with aged sheep's milk cheese, this spread is made with figs from the Croatian coast. After we tried it for the first time, we knew it had to be on our shelves. This spread pairs well with almost any cheese - from rich and creamy to dry and sharp. Love figs, but not with cheese? No problem. Spread liberally on toast with butter and enjoy with your morning coffee!

products.name: Dalmatia Sour Cherry Spread, 240g
products.description: Dalmatia uses perfectly-ripened Croatian sour cherries to make this delightful spread. A popular charcuterie board recommendation from our deli staff, this spread pairs especially well with tangy goat cheeses such as Florette, Humboldt Fog, or Bocconcino di Langa. It also makes an excellent filling for chocolate cake or cookies!

products.name: Girl Meets Dirt Bluebarb Preserves, 220g
products.description:
The Girl Meets Dirt crew is really into fruit, but their farmers grow great vegetables too! Time to fire up the peppers. The result is a not so usual pepper jelly. They gave it the old GMD spin and maxxed out the spiciness but added lots of local fruit and a bit of punchy organic vinegar (made from WA apples) for balance. The quince and apple add body to the set allowing GMD to stay committed to their ‘no pectin’ policy. It’s legit hot (yes!). It’s legit amazing. And it’s all natural.

In their Bluebarb Preserve, rhubarb, the harbinger of their season, with Cascadia blueberries and their classic French-inspired flair. This one is the PNW at her best.

products.name: Hotaru Matcha Milk Jam, 250g
products.description: Milk jam, a popular treat in Japan, is in the same family as long-simmered reductions of milk and sugar like dulce de leche, though without the caramelization. Creamy and thick enough to spread, this artisanal milk jam is slow-cooked with matcha green tea powder. The vibrant green jam has an earthy nuttiness, just a touch of caramelly-bitterness, and a pleasant modest sweetness. Excellent on brioche toast, drizzled over desserts, or served with sharp, aged cheeses.

products.name: Luxardo Maraschino Cherries, 400g
products.description: These cherries are the real deal. Produced the same way since 1905, they have no thickening agents or preservatives. Deep burgundy red in color, small, sweet and sour, they are a far cry from the electric red, processed maraschinos you found in your Shirley Temple as a kid. Without these cherries, no Manhattan is complete. Although ideal for cocktails, they are equally delicious right out of the jar, or spooned over ice cream and desserts.

products.name: Momofuku Chili Crunch Hot Honey, 220g
products.description:
Momofuku Chili Crunch Hot Honey is the sweet side of spicy. They combined their cult-favorite spicy-crunchy chili oil with premium wildflower honey to create the ultimate union of heat and sweet.

Developed by David Chang and the Momofuku Goods team, Chili Crunch Hot Honey is packed with the same chef-approved ingredients they use in their restaurants.

products.name: Ronnie's Blackstraw Jam, 240g
products.description:
BlackStraw Jam™ is a low sugar jam made of Washington Blackberries, Marionberries, Strawberries & Black Currants!

Still sweet, but with 33% less sugar than most jams, this is a delight on toast, muffins, pancakes and more...

Imagine a summer morning in the misty valleys of Washington State. The air is crisp, and the berries are ripe, their colors so vivid they could stop a painter mid-stroke. This is no ordinary jam. It’s an ode to nature’s wild elegance—a perfect storm of blackberry bramble, the deep, wine-dark allure of marionberries, the sun-kissed brightness of strawberries, and the brooding richness of black currants.

products.name: The French Beekeeper Wild Alfalfa Honey, 3oz
products.description: This is a raw wild flower honey produced in King County, Washington, by The French Beekeeper. It is a light hue, colored pale gold with a clean and uniform texture. The taste recalls fresh cut grass and hay. Plant notes are present but delicate, evoking freshly worked farmland rather than flowers.

products.name: Toschi Amarena Cherries
products.description: These iconic cherries need no introduction, but we’ll give them one anyway! Each elegantly designed jar is filled with carefully selected black sour cherries, suspended in a sweet syrup. If you’re garnishing something sweet, making a cake, or serving ice cream sundaes, these cherries are a must-have. Even the syrup is worth keeping once the fruit is gone – use it to flavor sodas, milkshakes, or popsicles.

products.name: Yakami Orchards Passion Fruit Marmalade, 290g
products.description: Made with traditional South Korean techniques using passion fruit, honey, and sugar. Elevate your cheese plate, excite your English muffin, or entice your senses in hot tea. Try it now and experience a burst of deliciousness.

products.name: Zab's Hot Honey, 12oz
products.description:
A sweet, slow burning drizzle for your cheese boards, marinades, pizza, and anything in between.

A new (but old) ingredient you most likely didn’t know you were missing. A rare and mysterious pepper from st. Augustine, Florida. Known for its signature “slow burn” and naturally sweet heat, it provides a subtle blend of fruity, tangy flavor with a gradual, tingly and lingering heat.

Despite mysterious origins, it has been a culinary staple and centerpiece of old Florida cuisine for 200+ years. We suspect the datil originated in the caribbean, and was brought to Florida in the late 1700’s/early 1800’s, where it became a local treasure, and evolved over time into the unique pepper it is today. Our datil peppers are grown with care on a small (but growing) farm just outside St. Augustine.
